snippet.title: Office Evolution Creator Pack | Trailer | Cities: Skylines II
snippet.description:
Office Evolution will be available on the 18th of March!

The brand new Creator Pack Office Evolution by Titan reshapes your high-density office zones with new signature buildings that blend heritage architecture and bold modern design. Your business districts are about to get a serious glow-up.

Available here: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/cities-skylines-ii/add-ons/cities-skylines-ii-office-evolution

All March 18 releases will be available individually, or together in the Office Evolution & City Stations Bundle for $21.99 / £18.49 / €21.99, saving 15% if you grab the bundle.
